cases.title: python3.11 stdlib client via ONE combined layer (wrapper + extension): extension covers what the shim cannot
PITFALL: bridge built with only 'pyopenssl cryptography' (as the tab says): urllib3 needs idna -> requests FAIL
cases.finding: Bridge step installs only pyopenssl + cryptography; urllib3.contrib.pyopenssl also imports idna, which the Lambda runtime lacks, so every urllib3/boto3 request raises ImportError. Add idna to the pip line (and build per Python version: the 3.11 abi3 cryptography wheel fails on 3.9/3.10).
